**Implementation note:** Full Turtle trade with stops is research code; the scale-in pyramid is the in-scope part.

## Description

Enter on a new N-day high/low breakout and exit on a shorter channel or stop; Turtle rules also specify volatility-based sizing.

## Where it may fit

Strong directional moves and volatility expansions; false breakouts are common in sideways markets.

## Vehicles

Managed futures/CTA, commodity and financial futures, liquid ETFs.

## Required data

Daily/intraday OHLC; rolling highs/lows; ATR or N-based volatility; contract specs; roll schedule.

## Caveats

A full system needs exits, pyramiding rules, risk sizing and portfolio diversification—not entries alone.
